journey.title: Tab stays inside the upload dialog when it contains a hidden button
journey.goal: Tabbing past the last visible control wraps to the start of the dialog

steps.title: Tab past the last visible control

functionalJourney.title: Upload a report with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens, uploads and closes

guards.title: Escape closes the upload dialog and returns focus
guards.goal: Escape dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

attempts.failure: Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 1213 (line 11 column 34)

plan.root_cause: The getFocusableNodes() method in MicroModal passes an array of selectors to querySelectorAll() instead of a comma-joined selector string, causing incorrect focusable element detection. This allows focus to escape the modal to external elements like the help link.
plan.repair_strategy: Fix getFocusableNodes() to join FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS with commas for proper querySelectorAll usage. This constrains focus trapping to actual modal-internal focusable elements.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will wrap within the modal's visible controls (filename input, upload button, close button) instead of escaping to external links. Meets WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 for keyboard focus containment.
functional_risks: If other modals rely on the previous broken selector behavior, their focus trapping may change
Array.from vs spread operator change is semantically equivalent for NodeList
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey: open modal, tab through controls, verify focus wraps to filename input after modal-close
Verify Escape key closes modal and returns focus to open button
Verify status text updates correctly on upload
